function.name: get_server_health
function.description: Checks the current CPU and memory usage of a specific server.

server_id.description: The ID of the server, e.g., 'payment-server-01'

function.name: fetch_recent_logs
function.description: Retrieves the most recent log entries from a server to diagnose errors.

lines.description: Number of log lines to fetch.

function.name: restart_service
function.description: Restarts a specific server service. Use this when CPU usage is critically high or the process is unresponsive.

server_id.description: The ID of the server to restart.

function.name: escalate_to_engineer
function.description: Escalates the issue to a human engineer.Use this when automated fixes fail, or when the error logs indicate a complex issue like a payment gateway failure.

summary.description: A brief summary of the findings (health status, log errors) and why you are escalating.
